projects.text: I built this portfolio website as a central space to showcase my projects, experience, and technical skills. The goal was to create a clean, minimal, and professional design that reflects my style while ensuring fast performance and easy navigation.

This group project involved developing a 3D data visualization application. The goal was to allow analysts to explore financial data in a virtual environment using Meta AR/VR glasses, providing a more immersive and intuitive way to interpret complex datasets.
